subject.title: feat(nodes): continue Claude catalog sessions on paired nodes via streaming CLI agent runs

question: Should OpenClaw core permanently adopt this streaming paired-node agent-run protocol and the new `nodeHost.agentRuns.claude.enabled` configuration surface for Claude catalog continuation?
rationale: The change is technically substantial and establishes durable core wire, configuration, session-placement, and command contracts; repository policy requires explicit maintainer intent rather than inferring acceptance from implementation quality alone.

options.title: Sponsor after fixes
options.body: Adopt the core direction after the two blocking defects are fixed, conflicts are resolved, compatibility surfaces are reviewed, and real paired-node proof is supplied.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Keep paired-node continuation but redesign it around a smaller private core execution seam without expanding the public Plugin SDK surface.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Leave paired-node Claude sessions view-only until a broader generic node-agent execution contract is designed and approved.

recommendation.title: Sponsor after fixes
recommendation.body: Adopt the core direction after the two blocking defects are fixed, conflicts are resolved, compatibility surfaces are reviewed, and real paired-node proof is supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects this person most directly to the existing catalog behavior and the cross-cutting agent, gateway, and node design involved in this decision.
